subject: BrightWave invoice intake: gateway choice and onboarding form questions
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@brightwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWave invoice intake: gateway choice and onboarding form questions

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. Before we cut over billing, procurement asked that we confirm BrightWave's preferred invoice submission path and a couple of template details so AP can process without delay. Two practical options are on the table:

1) Invoice Gateway (preferred for scale) — vendors upload to our portal (SFTP or web UI). Gateway enforces structured fields (PO number, GL code, unit price) and returns an automated ACK.
2) Email fallback — send invoices to billing@redwood.ai. This is allowed for small vendors but requires specific subject tokens and a matching filename convention to trigger auto-ingestion.

Questions for BrightWave:
- Which method do you prefer? (gateway vs email fallback)
- If email, can you include the PO number in both filename and subject (we sample below)?
- Do you need Redwood to accept multi-PO invoices (many line items across multiple PO numbers)?
- Can you produce a PDF with an itemized table (sample attached) or do you only deliver rendered PDFs from your billing system?

I've attached: 1) our onboarding form (to capture remittance/legal info) and 2) a BrightWave sample invoice we mocked up for fields alignment. Monica will own the onboarding form completion and Karthik will confirm PO-stamping expectations with Procurement.

Next steps: if you can reply with preferred intake method and a quick yes/no on the three bullets above, we can schedule the small integration window (typically 1–2 business days) and toggle the gateway rule.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Vendor Ops Programs
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-6291

Attachments: Redwood_onboarding-form.docx (docx), BrightWave_sample-invoice.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Soto <elena@brightwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BrightWave invoice intake: gateway choice and onboarding form questions

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear options. A few quick answers: we prefer the Invoice Gateway (SFTP/web) for recurring invoices — lower manual overhead on our side. We can also support the email fallback for ad-hoc or one-off charges.

Specific answers:
- Gateway preferred: yes. SFTP is our standard; web UI okay too.
- Email mode: we can include PO number in filename and Subject. Proposed subject format: "INVOICE | PO 7890123 | BrightWave".
- Multi-PO invoices: we generally send one PO per invoice. We can produce a multi-PO flattened PDF if absolutely required, but prefer single-PO per file.
- PDF format: we can render itemized PDFs from our ERP. Attached a current sample PDF (BrightWave_sample-invoice.pdf). The layout includes invoice number, PO, line items, unit price, tax and remittance instructions.

A couple of notes from billing: when using the gateway, can Redwood provide the exact SFTP path and an example ACK payload? Also, please confirm whether Redwood expects a separate EDI/CSV for line items or if the PDF is sufficient for your AP.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if needed.

Best,
Elena Soto
Director, Revenue Operations
BrightWave Media
elena@brightwave.com
Attachments: BrightWave_sample-invoice.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWave invoice intake: gateway choice and onboarding form questions

Kim / Monica —

Quick procurement note before we finalize: Redwood requires PO stamping for any invoice above $5,000 for auto-approval. That means the PO number must be prominent in the document body and filename when using email fallback. For gateway ingestion, we prefer an explicit PO field in the uploaded metadata so we can do deterministic matching. If BrightWave will do single-PO per file, matching will be straightforward.

Also: if BrightWave chooses SFTP, please ask them to use the folder convention: /redwood/vendor/brightwave/incoming and include a small SHA1 hash in the ACK payload so we can reconcile with uploaded file names. I'll share the SFTP credentials + example ACK schema once procurement signs the onboarding form.

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@brightwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWave invoice intake: gateway choice and onboarding form questions

Hi Elena —

Great — thanks for the quick detail. Summary and next steps so nothing gets dropped:

Summary: BrightWave prefers SFTP Gateway. You will provide single-PO per invoice PDFs rendered from your ERP. Email fallback accepted for exceptions with subject token format: "INVOICE | PO [PO#] | BrightWave".

Next steps:
- Monica: I'll send the onboarding form link separately; Elena, please complete the remittance and W-9 fields and return the signed DocuSign by EOD Thursday. (Link will be sent.)
- Karthik: please prepare the SFTP path, credentials, and ACK payload spec; add SHA1 optional reconciliation field.
- Elena/BrightWave: upload a sample file to the gateway test folder (we'll send credentials) or reply with a confirmed sample if you prefer us to pull.

I'll loop in IT to coordinate a short test window after credentials are exchanged. If everyone is aligned, we can make this live for September invoices.

Thanks again — small ask but will save a lot of manual work downstream.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Vendor Ops Programs
Redwood Inference
